annotation.coverageReview: Actually inspected six original survey views, individual original front and final four-patch front/side overlay after expanding the sparsely sampled battle bill. Gust Tern has one navy feathered head, large eye rims, orange triangular beak and white cheek above navy scarf. Expanded green bill patch covers bill and adjacent facial cheek; red patch covers distal bill and magenta the lower white cheek. Scarf, wing feathers and large pale tail fan need independent full-body inspection.

source.detail: Actually inspected all 24 final source and regenerated battle front/side head/body slices. Repaired white eye surround and cheek retain outline through attack, cast, recoil, jump and death; orange upper/lower bill remains joined. Navy scarf and feathered chest move independently; folded gray wings, slender legs and white fan tail remain continuous without new creases or spikes across all 13 clips.

battle.detail: Actually inspected all 24 final source and regenerated battle front/side head/body slices. Repaired white eye surround and cheek retain outline through attack, cast, recoil, jump and death; orange upper/lower bill remains joined. Navy scarf and feathered chest move independently; folded gray wings, slender legs and white fan tail remain continuous without new creases or spikes across all 13 clips.

productionTransitions.detail: Actually inspected all 32 original low and medium production transition slices and six native companion sheets. Repaired eye-rim and cheek stay stable alongside joined orange bill in strike, cast, stagger, dodge, dead and revive; scarf folds and body lean do not pull the face. White torso, gray wings, spread brown feet and fan tail remain continuous. All 24 advancing idle frames keep face and body proportions.

companionVisualReview.scope: Unchanged production companion component with local final battle asset, 24 advancing idle frames.

secondVisualPass.scope: All 24 enlarged repeated source/battle raw front/side face/body slices, all 32 enlarged low/mobile and medium/desktop production runtime slices and all six native companion sheets actually inspected. Repairs also received candidate visual inspection.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged baseline source/battle front/side whole-face and body sheets across 13 clips and six phases. Orange bill and lower bill remain rigid, but side cheek/eye-rim probes drift independently of the head; the cheek/scarf border shifts during nod, recoil and jumping. Full-body wings, breast, legs, talons and white fan tail remain connected. Keep unresolved pending measured face/cloth boundary diagnosis; no approval or completion claimed. Candidate targets measured cheek and lower-face drift, with a smooth transition into the mobile neck. Source geometry, textures, rig and curves must remain exact; independent probe, full-body geometry and actual candidate visual inspection required before promotion.

Actually inspected all 24 enlarged baseline source/battle front/side whole-face and body sheets across 13 clips and six phases. The detailed source white chin visibly elongates below the bill during attack/cast lift, folds during recoil, and is drawn toward the moving blue scarf. The battle version looks steadier but also fails the independent face probe. Brown wings, rear tail, headband ties, legs and talons remain connected. Repair and repeated review required; no approval or completion claimed. Candidate targets measured cheek and lower-face drift, with a smooth transition into the mobile neck. Source geometry, textures, rig and curves must remain exact; independent probe, full-body geometry and actual candidate visual inspection required before promotion. First candidate rejected: seven attack, recoil and death poses show new neck transition edge warnings, including edge 2214/2215 and 2351/2350. Candidate v2 widens the vertical fade below the chin and retains continuous influence packing; all face/body checks and actual visual inspection are required. Candidate v2 rejected: five remaining neck-side fade warnings at edges 18165/18166 and 1406/1393. Candidate v3 widens the depth and lateral transition instead of accepting those warnings; original geometry and motion remain preserved. Candidate v3 rejected: one remaining death crease at edge 4916/4917 below the neck. Candidate v4 extends the smooth vertical transition below that measured crease; original geometry and motion remain preserved. Candidate v4 rejected: wider vertical blend introduces six lower-body seam warnings. Candidate v5 projects the already visually inspected and zero-warning original battle binding onto the exact detailed surface, then keeps the independently selected face core rigid. This requires exact reference replay plus preservation of geometry, textures, bone nodes and animation curves, and complete candidate visual review.
